title: Tiny, cute pretzel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD966' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD966' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- pretzel base shape -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 50 52)'>
    <!-- left loop -->
    <path d='M48 68 Q28 68 24 52 Q20 36 34 34 Q44 33 46 44 Q48 52 42 56 Q36 60 32 52 Q30 46 36 44' 
          fill='none' stroke='#D4930D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- right loop -->
    <path d='M52 68 Q72 68 76 52 Q80 36 66 34 Q56 33 54 44 Q52 52 58 56 Q64 60 68 52 Q70 46 64 44' 
          fill='none' stroke='#D4930D' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- bottom cross -->
    <path d='M38 66 Q50 74 62 66' 
          fill='none' stroke='#E8A817' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- highlight on left -->
    <path d='M44 42 Q42 38 38 38' 
          fill='none' stroke='#F5C842' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- highlight on right -->
    <path d='M56 42 Q58 38 62 38' 
          fill='none' stroke='#F5C842' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- salt crystals -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <!-- cute eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3D2B00'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3D2B00'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='47.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='47.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- happy blush -->
    <ellipse cx='35' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9C6B' opacity='0.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='65' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9C6B' opacity='0.6'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M46 56 Q50 60 54 56' 
          fill='none' stroke='#3D2B00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
